brief:
Settlers expanded a settlement outpost located in the Wadi al-Zeitoun area on lands belonging to Umm Safah village, north of Ramallah, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources confirmed that the settlers are continuing construction and expansion work at the outpost, which was previously established on village territory in the region.

The expansion represents the latest in a series of development activities at the site. Settlers have maintained a presence in the area and have been actively working to enlarge the outpost's footprint on the disputed lands.
